<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input signal representing the multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="partial_products" width="8" depth="4">Stores partial products.</register>
        <register id="accumulator" width="8">Accumulates the sum of partial products.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend inputs by adding 'size' number of zero bits at the most significant bit positions
        reg [7:0] a_extended;
        reg [7:0] b_extended;
        assign a_extended = {mul_a, 4'b0};
        assign b_extended = {mul_b, 4'b0};

        // Generate partial products
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < size; i = i + 1) begin : partial_product_gen
                always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                    if (!rst_n) begin
                        partial_products[i] <= 8'b0;
                    end else begin
                        if (b_extended[i]) begin
                            partial_products[i] <= a_extended << i;
                        end else begin
                            partial_products[i] <= 8'b0;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        endgenerate

        // Add partial products
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                accumulator <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                accumulator <= partial_products[0] + partial_products[1] + partial_products[2] + partial_products[3];
            end
        end

        // Output the final product
        assign mul_out = accumulator;
    </implementation>
</module>
